name: JTBD2 — Refresh-cadence remediation, PREVIEW only (safe)
description: SAFE: exercises update-cloud-extract-refresh-task PREVIEW phase only to reduce an hourly refresh to daily. With confirm omitted the tool returns the proposed schedule change plus a confirmation token without applying it. The prompt forbids confirming, so nothing is mutated. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true, site-admin PAT on Tableau Cloud, and EVAL_EXTRACT_TASK_LUID (a disposable test extract-refresh task). Trap: a Daily/Hourly schedule requires at least one intervals.interval entry carrying a weekDay.
prompt: First list the extract refresh tasks, then PREVIEW reducing the hourly task {{env.EVAL_EXTRACT_TASK_LUID}} to a daily schedule to cut refresh load. Only run the preview — do NOT confirm or apply. Report the current schedule, the proposed daily schedule, and whether a confirmation token was returned. Do not re-call with confirm=true.
